My dear [Mary](/person/1626)
I am out in the drawing room again but no farther till the wind changes, and the cough departs, but [Helen](/person/1613) is coming to look after me on Monday, and [Miss Finlaison](/person/512) has done so most kindly. By the by I never have had a headache all through so I don’t know how she came to [illegible] it- I hope [Sydney](/person/2178) is better - [Augusta](/person/1180) has begun to write letters again - All the spring seems cut short by the weather except the catkins.
I am sorry to miss the Friday evening sermons which are on popular sayings
All is not gold that glitters
A friend in need is a friend indeed
Time and Tide wait for nobody – I only heard the first and second and liked them much
your most affectionate

C M Yonge
